name: Nordreth Station 29 Original
description: This listing is an infrasound monitoring booth listed with floor area 70 square metres, noise floor 23 dBA, occupancy 5 people. Its remaining stated figures are session length 6 hours, session fee set after acceptance, isolation method resilient floating. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.

reviews.title: Good, with one reservation about this listing
reviews.text: Went through the whole infrasound monitoring booth catalogue twice before this listing. The documentation with this listing is thin, and we worked out the rest ourselves. We would still recommend this listing, with that said up front.

reviews.title: Specified for the listed rate
reviews.text: This listing was not the cheapest infrasound monitoring booth we considered, and that was fine. The figure that mattered was the session fee: the listed rate. We never looked at the other axes once the listed rate checked out.

reviews.title: 5 people is the right occupancy for us
reviews.text: Replaced a much older infrasound monitoring booth with this listing last season. Everything came down to occupancy, and 5 people is what we needed. At 5 people it does not need to stand out anywhere else.
